connector.name: Obris
connector.registryDescription: Stop re-explaining yourself to AI. Save knowledge once, use it in every conversation.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.obris.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package obris-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.obris, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
